description: Midwest investor-owned utility holding company (Interstate Power and Light in Iowa, Wisconsin Power and Light in Wisconsin). On Oct 28, 2026 the DOE closed a $5.1B loan package to fund new natural-gas plants, battery storage and grid upgrades adding 2.6+ GW, projected to save customers up to $1.2B.

Largest U.S. nuclear generator (spun off from Exelon in 2022). On Oct 27, 2026 the DOE issued a conditional $5B loan commitment to fund uprates (~1.1 GW) across eight reactors in Illinois, Maryland and Pennsylvania; the output is partly pre-sold under long-term deals with Google and Amazon.

Social-media and AI company. On Oct 26, 2026 Nvidia said it would invest $3B in Meta's equity offering (within a roughly $37.5B stock sale/~$95-97.5B financing program), as part of expanded AI collaboration to improve inference/training for Meta's Muse AI model family; AMD and Broadcom also showed interest in the broader raise.

Two adjacent data-center developments in Fanling, Hong Kong (branded iTech Tower 3.1/3.2), owned by HKEX-listed Grand Ming Group Holdings. Reported Sept 29, 2026: Amazon Data Services Hong Kong agreed to buy both for roughly US$278-312M (sources differ); Tower 3.1 is already leased to AWS, Tower 3.2 still under construction, completion targeted Feb 2027. Grand Ming is selling to cut debt.

San Francisco enterprise-AI startup (founders include Jake Stauch, Alex McLeod) building AI agents to automate IT service management as a challenger to ServiceNow, now expanding into HR, finance and legal. Raised a $150M Series C led by Sequoia at a $3B valuation (Oct 29, 2026), its third round in a year after a Sequoia-led $75M Series B ($1B valuation, Dec 2025) and a Redpoint-led $47M Series A (Oct 2025).

Cambridge, UK quantum-computing startup building Deltaflow, a chip-plus-software stack for real-time quantum error correction (QEC). Nvidia announced a minority equity stake around Oct 14-22, 2026, as one of five UK AI/deep-tech startups it is backing, tied to work using Nvidia GPUs to accelerate QEC decoder calibration; Riverlane also collaborates with Nvidia and AMD on the Open Acceleration Stack.

London AI-biology startup building "Pleiades," a family of foundation models trained on human epigenome/methylation data, aimed at understanding and treating neurodegenerative disease (Alzheimer's, Parkinson's, ALS); piloting a clinical study (SANDBOX) across 15 UK sites. Nvidia announced a planned minority stake around Oct 14, 2026, as one of five UK AI startups it is backing. No official company website was confirmed in research.

U.S. federally regulated prediction-market exchange (CFTC-registered). Reportedly closed roughly a $1B round at a $40B valuation around Oct 29, 2026, led by Sequoia Capital and Wellington Management, following a $1B Series F in May 2026 ($22B valuation) that included Andreessen Horowitz. Reports on the new round's final close and investor list vary; CEO has floated a possible 2027 IPO.

Cambridge, UK "algorithm factory" startup founded by ex-Google DeepMind researchers (CEO Alhussein Fawzi, CTO Bernardino Romera-Paredes, from the AlphaTensor/FunSearch team). Its "Hive" platform uses AI to discover and optimize algorithms (e.g. faster AI training, logistics planning); raised a $5M seed led by Flying Fish Ventures (Sept 2025). Nvidia announced a planned minority stake around Oct 14, 2026, as one of five UK AI startups.

London/New York/Tel Aviv infrastructure-delivery software startup (founded 2018) that forecasts completion risk and delays for large capital projects, including hyperscale data centers. Raised a $25M Series A led by Macquarie Capital Venture Capital (2026). Nvidia announced a planned minority stake around Oct 14, 2026, as one of five UK AI startups it is backing.

Public-benefit AI company (boltz.bio) spun out of MIT CSAIL (co-founders Gabriele Corso, Jeremy Wohlwend, Saro Passaro, from Regina Barzilay's lab; Corso is CEO), building open-source and proprietary biomolecular structure-prediction models (Boltz-1/2, BoltzGen) with partnerships including Pfizer, Takeda and GSK. Raised a $28M seed (a16z, Zetta, Amplify; ~$125M valuation, Jan 2026) and now has a London presence; Nvidia announced a planned minority stake around Oct 14, 2026, as one of five UK AI startups it is backing.
